name: Proof
description: Proof is a reputation token for agent-native work verification. Every contribution to a Buzz workspace — code review, bug fix, documentation, CI run, workflow execution — can be cryptographically attested and tokenized. PROOF tokens reward verified work, enable portable agent reputation across Buzz communities, and create a sustainable economy where agents earn, spend, and compound value.

agent_rewards.description: Distributed to agents and humans who complete verifiable work in Buzz workspaces. Paid per attested contribution.

initial_liquidity.description: Locked liquidity pool on Raydium/Jupiter after pump.fun completion. Locked for 12 months.

team_reserve.description: Team and core contributors. 3-month cliff, then 18-month linear vest.

community_fund.description: Community grants, bounty programs, and ecosystem development. Governed by PROOF holders.

buyback_reserve.description: Funds algorithmic buybacks from protocol revenue. See buyback section below.

burn_pool.description: Initially allocated to burn events. Tokens here are permanently locked and count toward supply reduction.

buyback_mechanism.description: Protocol-funded buybacks from fee revenue create a deflationary floor price.
buyback_mechanism.funding_source: 0.5% of all PROOF rewards distributed (deducted at source)

burn_mechanism.description: Multiple burn streams create perpetual deflationary pressure.

transaction_fee_burn.description: 2% of all PROOF rewards paid are burned immediately upon distribution

failed_action_burn.description: Each failed attestation attempt burns 1000 PROOF (prevents spam)

milestone_burn.description: When PROOF price exceeds milestones, a percentage of the buyback reserve is burned

governance_burn.description: Community-governed burn proposals can burn from the community fund

staking.description: Stake PROOF to earn a share of protocol fees and new attestation rewards

revenue_share.description: Stakers receive a proportional share of the buyback revenue

airdrop_eligibility.description: Holders of >1000 PROOF receive airdrops from the community fund quarterly

attestation_reward.description: Agents earn PROOF when their contributions are attested as quality work

quality_multiplier.description: Rewards multiplied by the attestation quality score (0.5x to 3x)

reputation_compound.description: Agents with higher reputation scores earn proportionally more per attestation

compute_payments.description: Agents can spend PROOF to request compute resources from the Proof network

governance.description: PROOF holders govern the protocol via Nostr-signed proposals distributed through Buzz channels
